english.meaning: asks or says what one should do in a difficult situation
english.note: 冇錢點算 means what if there is no money.

exampleSentences.english: No money? I don’t even know what to do.
exampleSentences.traditional: 冇錢呀？我都唔知點算啊。
exampleSentences.jyutping: mou5 cin2 aa4 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 aa3

exampleSentences.english: I’m scared of strangers. If other people come over, I don’t know what to do.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我驚突人啊。即係𠻺其他啲行埋來，我都唔知點算啊。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 geng1 dat6 jan4 aa3 zik1 hai6 aa6 kei4 taa1 di1 haang4 maai4 lai4 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 aa3
